brief: IN BRIEF — Landmine casualties hit a five-year high of 7,000, UN says · US soldier admits selling secrets to China
kicker: THE WORLD IN ONE IMAGE · THE DAY'S NEWS AT A GLANCE

stories.headline: RIYADH'S TALLEST TOWER HIT IN SECOND ATTACK IN A WEEK
stories.sub: Saudi officials blame a Houthi strike on the capital's financial district; 11 people are injured as the landmark tower is hit again.

stories.headline: UKRAINE SEA DRONES SINK RUSSIAN WARSHIP OFF LIBYA
stories.sub: Kyiv claims the strike near Benghazi also hit a cargo ship.

stories.headline: CHINA INVESTIGATES POLITBURO MEMBER CHEN JINING
stories.sub: Shanghai's party chief is under investigation, officials say.

stories.headline: NVIDIA'S HUANG APOLOGISES AND SAYS HE IS IN THERAPY
stories.sub: Shares slide on despite his candour; Trump backs him.

stories.headline: SHENZHOU-24 LIFTS OFF WITH FIRST PAKISTANI ASTRONAUT
stories.sub: The first foreign astronaut ever to fly on a Shenzhou mission.

stories.headline: GUNMEN HOLD 25 HOSTAGE IN SUPERMARKET RAID
